lede: The week kicks off with Halloween running full tilt through the valley — parade, Young Frankenstein the musical, the Witches Ride, and a stretch of parties and open houses that carry right through Saturday night. Once the costumes come off, the most concrete government action this week is a Planning and Zoning Chair meeting Monday, November 2, where a lot-line vacation at 510 W Columbia Avenue is on the table. Most other boards either haven't posted agendas or are handling routine business.

notable.stake: P&Z votes on merging two lots at 510 W Columbia into one 5,625-sq-ft parcel.
